response.sql: WITH r AS (SELECT r.raceId, r.round, r.circuitId, c.country FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId), circuit_avg AS (SELECT circuitId, country, AVG(round) AS circuit_avg_round FROM r GROUP BY circuitId, country), country_avg AS (SELECT country, AVG(round) AS country_avg_round FROM r GROUP BY country) SELECT ca.circuitId, ca.country, ca.circuit_avg_round, ca.circuit_avg_round - co.country_avg_round AS diff FROM circuit_avg ca JOIN country_avg co ON co.country = ca.country ORDER BY diff DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10;
